name: Stats card
description: By the numbers: a headline, up to three big figures with what each means, and an optional dark note card, on the brand's paper. Every figure is a claim that needs a source. Ported from the automatos-social stats family.

eyebrow.label: Eyebrow
eyebrow.description: A short label in the dark pill, e.g. WHY IT MATTERS. Leave empty for none.

headline.label: Headline
headline.description: The big statement. Use | to break the line, e.g. THE|HARNESS|IS THE|PRODUCT.

headline_accent.label: Accent words
headline_accent.description: Words of the headline shown in the brand colour, exactly as they appear in it. Leave empty for none.

stat_1_value.label: Figure 1
stat_1_value.description: The first big figure, e.g. 5x or 80%. A claim: bind it to its source.

stat_1_label.label: Figure 1 meaning
stat_1_label.description: What the first figure says, in a sentence.

stat_2_value.label: Figure 2
stat_2_value.description: The second big figure. A claim: bind it to its source.

stat_2_label.label: Figure 2 meaning
stat_2_label.description: What the second figure says, in a sentence.

stat_3_value.label: Figure 3
stat_3_value.description: A third big figure. A claim: bind it to its source. Leave empty for none.

stat_3_label.label: Figure 3 meaning
stat_3_label.description: What the third figure says, in a sentence. Leave empty for none.

note_title.label: Note heading
note_title.description: The heading of the dark note card under the figures. Leave empty for none.

note_body.label: Note text
note_body.description: One or two sentences of context in the note card. Leave empty for none.

counter.label: Page counter
counter.description: For a post in a series, e.g. 02 / 10. Leave empty for none.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: The account handle shown top right, e.g. @yourbrand. Leave empty for none.

cta.label: Call to action
cta.description: The footer's call to action, e.g. Swipe to know more. Leave empty for none.

sample_data.headline: THE|HARNESS|IS THE|PRODUCT.
sample_data.stat_1_label: Manus rewrote its harness five times in six months. Same model, better results.
sample_data.stat_2_label: What Meta paid for Manus: not for a model, for the harness engineering.
sample_data.stat_3_label: The share of its agent's tools Vercel removed, and got faster, better results.
sample_data.note_body: Changing only the harness moved a LangChain agent from outside the top 30 to the top 5 on TerminalBench 2.0.
